page_title: NAP 2-0 MON | Napoli v Monza 29/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Gianluca Manganiello is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+1' Here is a change. Stanislav Lobotka is going off and Antonio Conte gives the last tactical orders to Billy Gilmour (Napoli).
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mathias Olivera leaves the pitch and Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) comes on.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
88' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 1:3.
87' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Pedro Pereira walks off the pitch to be replaced by Kevin Martins (Monza).
87' Antonio Conte has decided to substitute Romelu Lukaku and he is replaced by Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli).
87' Matteo Politano goes off the pitch and David Neres (Napoli) comes on.
84' Daniel Maldini (Monza) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that crashes into the defensive wall. The opposition's goalkeeper set it up perfectly.
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Gianluca Caprari (Monza) will replace Alessandro Bianco.
82' Alessandro Nesta has decided to make a change. Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza) replaces Armando Izzo.
78' The ratio of the ball possession is 54:46.
75' It's time for a substitution. Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) comes on in place of Khvicha Kvaratskhelia.
74' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Stefano Turati comes off the line to clear the ball away.
72' Some patient build-up play from Monza as they look to unlock the defence.
68' Andrea Carboni (Monza) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar.
65' Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle. Scott McTominay (Napoli) commits a foul after dangerous play.
63' PENALTY APPEAL by Napoli, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
61' Close effort! Daniel Maldini (Monza) takes the resulting free kick from a promising distance, but he sends it narrowly wide of the right post.
59' 8:0 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
58' Monza earn a corner.
55' Scott McTominay (Napoli) watches the corner all the way, but places his header a whisker wide of the left post from close range.
54' The referee awards a corner and Matteo Politano (Napoli) goes over to take it.

53' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The ball goes behind for a corner. Napoli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
52' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) is penalised for a foul. Gianluca Manganiello had a clear view and blows his whistle.
49' The Monza players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Daniel Maldini (Monza) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
40' Napoli exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely.
36' Armando Izzo (Monza) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.
33' 2 - 0 Goal! 2:0. Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.

32' Scott McTominay (Napoli) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
30' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 4:0.
26' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Gianluca Manganiello had an easy-decision to make.
24' Daniel Maldini (Monza) is shown a yellow card by the referee for a bad sliding tackle on an opponent.

22' 1 - 0 An amazing individual effort from Matteo Politano (Napoli) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom left corner and makes it 1:0. Stefano Turati was helpless.
21' Scott McTominay (Napoli) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the left post.
18' 48:52 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
16' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
13' Napoli are seeing far more of the ball now.
11' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) gathers the pass and without hesitation smashes a shot in from long range, but it goes high over the bar.
8' Matteo Pessina (Monza) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
6' Monza get a corner.
5' Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) sends a long ball in, but Stefano Turati comfortably gathers the ball.
3' Monza keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Monza will take the kick-off.
Gianluca Manganiello is the one to supervise the game today.
